items.originalTitle: Does Daniel Ricciardo regret leaving Red Bull for Renault?
items.summaryEn: Daniel Ricciardo reflects on his career-defining decision in 2018 to leave Red Bull for Renault. In July 2018, he had spent a decade in the Red Bull family and was spearheading the brand's world championship effort.
detailZh: 里卡多是否后悔离开红牛转投雷诺？
里卡多敞开心扉，谈2018年那个定义其职业生涯的决定
亚历克斯·阿尔本（红牛）领先丹尼尔·里卡多（雷诺）
2018年7月，丹尼尔·里卡多是F1围场中评价最高的车手之一。自早期初级方程式生涯起，他已在红牛体系内十年，此时正领衔该品牌在世界锦标赛中的争夺。
但当西里尔·阿比特博尔带着雷诺F1的合同找上门时，里卡多决定做出那个大胆的转变，尽管他在2018赛季前半段已经赢下两场大奖赛，而黄色赛车的最好成绩也不过是第五名。
这场赌博没有收到回报。里卡多在2019年未能取得任何一次领奖台完赛，雷诺在车队积分榜上被迈凯伦击败，排在第四，而他甚至在2020赛季开始前——该赛季因新冠疫情而推迟——就已经与这支位于沃金的队伍签下了2021年的合同。
这位澳大利亚人在迈凯伦过得极其艰难，除了2021年意大利大奖赛上令人震惊的胜利之外，他的表现糟糕到没能履行完合同，并在2023赛季被同胞奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里取代。他在老东家AlphaTauri/小红牛车队的最后一段时光也没有好转——同样因为表现不佳而提前结束。
与此同时，前队友马克斯·维斯塔潘持续攀升，最终随红牛车队连续拿下四个世界冠军——而这支车队正是里卡多自己主动离开的。

八年之后，在《Beyond The Grid》播客中被问及是否后悔离开红牛时，里卡多沉思道：“我其实仍然不知道该怎么回答，因为我绝对不想说‘哦，是的，如果我留下来，我本会成为世界冠军’，因为那并不是一个真实发生过的现实。马克斯已经证明了自己是有史以来最优秀的车手之一，所以我也不想贬低这一点，然后说‘是的，我本会击败马克斯并成为世界冠军’。那不会是一件容易的事，但我觉得那样说对他可能也有点不公平。显然我非常尊重他。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，向杆位得主丹尼尔·里卡多，红牛车队表示祝贺
“我绝对承认，那是一个……如果我告诉你发生的一切，那真是疯狂的决定。”
推动里卡多做出这一决定的，部分原因是在红牛体系内待了十年之后，他需要改变。
“如果简短回答的话，是的，我希望我当初留下来了，但是……我不知道，当时我离开是因为我觉得自己变得有点安逸、有点自满了，”他继续说道。“我觉得有一种想尝试其他东西的渴望。事情并不是那么黑白分明。
“如果我能成为世界冠军，那是我最好的机会吗？是的，绝对是。我很想知道如果我留下来会是另一种怎样的现实。我不想说这让我耿耿于怀，但这是唯一一个未知数，让我觉得‘嗯，我非常好奇那会如何发展’。”
但里卡多非常清楚，维斯塔潘速度极快，而且失误越来越少。“也存在另一种现实，那就是马克斯不断进步、不断积累势头，我不知道——我是否还能继续保持提升？很难说，”他承认道。
“2018年我赢了一些比赛，拿到过一个杆位。我仍然非常有能力，所以我不怀疑自己有能力继续与马克斯竞争，但是……这很难说。
“很明显，从那一刻起，是的，这条河有些蜿蜒和崎岖。那无疑是一个关键时刻。所以，如果能重来，我会留下吗——我是否绝对好奇会发生什么？是的，答案是肯定的。如果你想称之为遗憾或好奇或其他什么，那么我会说是的。”
detailEn: Does Daniel Ricciardo regret leaving Red Bull for Renault?
Daniel Ricciardo opens up about the career-defining decision he made in 2018
Alex Albon, Red Bull Racing leads Daniel Ricciardo, Renault F1 Team

Back in July 2018, Daniel Ricciardo was one of the most highly-rated drivers in the Formula 1 paddock. He had been in the Red Bull family for a decade, since his early junior single-seater career, and was now spearheading the brand’s effort in the world championship.

But when Cyril Abiteboul came knocking with a Renault F1 deal, Ricciardo decided to make that bold switch, even though he had won two grands prix in the first half of the 2018 season while the yellow cars had failed to finish any better than fifth.

The gamble didn’t pay off. Ricciardo failed to achieve a single podium finish in 2019, Renault was beaten to fourth by McLaren in the constructors’ championship, and he signed with the Woking-based outfit for 2021 even before the 2020 campaign got under way – having been delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic.

The Australian tremendously struggled at McLaren, other than a shock victory in the 2021 Italian Grand Prix, so much that he didn’t see his contract out and was replaced by fellow countryman Oscar Piastri for the 2023 season. His fortunes did not improve in a final stint at his old AlphaTauri/RB team – which was cut short by his underperformance too.
Meanwhile, former team-mate Max Verstappen kept rising and eventually took four consecutive world titles with the Red Bull squad Ricciardo had left of his own volition.

Eight years on, when asked in the Beyond The Grid podcast if he regretted leaving Red Bull, Ricciardo pondered: “I still don’t really know how to answer it, because I definitely don’t want to say, ‘Oh, yeah, I would have been world champion if I stayed’, because it’s not a reality that was lived. Max has gone on to prove he is one of the best ever, so I don’t want to dismiss that as well and be like, ‘Yeah, I would have beat Max and become world champion’. It wouldn’t have been an easy task, but I think it’s also maybe a bit unfair towards him to say that. Obviously I respect him a lot.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, congratulates pole man Daniel Ricciardo, Red Bull Racing
“I acknowledge definitely that it was a decision that was… If I tell you everything that went on, it was wild.”
What drove Ricciardo’s decision was, in part, a need for change, after that decade in the Red Bull fold.

“If I’m to answer it shortly, yes, I wish I would have stayed, but… I don’t know, at the time, I left because I felt I was getting a bit comfortable, a bit complacent,” he continued. “I think there was a desire to try something else. It’s not that black and white.

“If I could have been a world champion, was that my best opportunity? Yes, absolutely. I would have loved to have known another reality of if I stayed. I don’t want to say it haunts me, but it’s the one unknown that I’m like, ‘Hmm, I’m so interested how that would have panned out’.”

But Ricciardo was only too aware that Verstappen was extremely quick and making fewer and fewer errors. “There’s also a reality where Max kept getting better, kept getting momentum, and I don’t know – would I have kept lifting? It’s hard to say,” he admitted.
“I won some races that 2018 year, I got a pole. I was still very capable, so I’m not doubting my abilities to have kept competing with Max, but… it’s a hard one.

“It’s clear that from that point on, yes, the river was a little winding and rough. That was a pivotal moment, for sure. So, if I could relive it, would I stay – and am I absolutely curious about what would have happened? Yes, the answer is yes. If you want to call it regret or curiosity or whatever, then I will say yes.”

keyPointsEn: Ricciardo had been in the Red Bull family since his early junior single-seater career, a decade by 2018

items.originalTitle: Cadillac 'honoured' to have Sergio Perez as special 300th race celebration planned for Mexico GP
items.summaryEn: General Motors president Mark Reuss has praised Cadillac Formula 1 driver Sergio Perez, insisting it is "an honour" to have the Mexican on side. Perez will contest his 300th F1 race at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez in Mexico City, becoming only the seventh driver in F1 history to reach the milestone.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克为佩雷兹第300场比赛筹备墨西哥站特别庆祝活动
通用汽车总裁马克·罗伊斯在塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹迎来墨西哥里程碑之战前向他致敬
通用汽车总裁马克·罗伊斯在塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹迎来个人第300场F1比赛前称赞了这位凯迪拉克F1车手，坚称拥有这位墨西哥车手是"荣幸"。
佩雷兹将成为F1历史上第七位达到这一里程碑的车手——此前六位是鲁本斯·巴里切罗、费尔南多·阿隆索、简森·巴顿、刘易斯·汉密尔顿、基米·莱科宁和迈克尔·舒马赫——他将在墨西哥城罗德里格斯兄弟赛道、在主场车迷的支持下庆祝这一成就。
作为活动的一部分，佩雷斯在改革大道上进行了一场演示驾驶。他还将在驾驶MAC-26上赛道之前，拜访该市的通用汽车员工。凯迪拉克还宣布与这位墨西哥车手续约至2029年。
鲁斯在纽约汽车运动商业交流会上发言时被问及庆祝活动，他说：“这是件大事。”
“这将是切科的第三百场比赛，非常自豪他能为我们车队驾驶，他给了我们很多反馈，作为一位跑过这些赛道的人，他提供了专业经验——还有[瓦尔特利]博塔斯——两人都为我们提供了关于赛车、赛道以及差异所在、如何构建模型、以及在我们经历首个赛季的过程中如何让模拟数据准确的真实反馈。”
“这对他来说是件大事。对通用汽车来说也是件大事。我们的墨西哥总部就在墨西哥城，所以他将与我们的经销商交流，与我们的员工交流，我迫不及待想去和他以及他所有的车迷一起参与其中。”
他只是一个很棒的人，作为一个人来说就是这样；因为他不仅是一位出色的车手，也是凯迪拉克、通用汽车和一级方程式赛车的一位出色代表，而且他真的是一个非常好的人。
能拥有他是一种荣幸。
佩雷斯和博塔斯本赛季加入了凯迪拉克的首个F1赛季，为这个通用汽车品牌带来了赢得比赛的经验，因为该品牌首次踏入了单座赛车运动的巅峰。
虽然本赛季远非一帆风顺，这对于一支从零开始组建的新车队来说是意料之中的，但罗伊斯对两位车手展现出的品格印象深刻。
“他们非常不同，”他透露道。“任何系列赛中的任何车手，如果他们真的非常优秀，都会非常不同。
“在那种专业精神和精准度上，无论是什么系列赛，不管是耐力赛、一级方程式、越野赛、卡车赛，我不管是什么，你都能在冠军身上看到这一点，他们每场比赛都力求做到最好、做到极致，如果他们没做到，如果发生了什么事——你不可能赢下每一场比赛，没有人能赢下每一场比赛——当他们遇到不幸的一天或犯了错误时，他们会从那场比赛中走出来，并完善自己的技艺，无论是赛车、他们自身、他们的身体素质，还是别的什么。
“他们为那份完美而驾驶，这两位先生都是如此，他们真的明白需要付出什么以及这个过程。说实话，我非常非常高兴他们对我们有耐心。
“这需要一个特别的人，而这两个家伙都具备这一点。”
detailEn: Cadillac 'honoured' to have Sergio Perez as special 300th race celebration planned for Mexico GP
General Motors president Mark Reuss has paid tribute to Sergio Perez as he prepares for his milestone race in Mexico
General Motors president Mark Reuss has praised Cadillac Formula 1 driver Sergio Perez ahead of his 300th race in the series, insisting it is "an honour" to have the Mexican on side.

Perez will become just the seventh driver in F1 history to reach the milestone - joining Rubens Barrichello, Fernando Alonso, Jenson Button, Lewis Hamilton, Kimi Raikkonen and Michael Schumacher - and will celebrate the achievement in front of his adoring home support at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez in Mexico City.

As part of the occasion, Perez has taken to the streets for a demonstration run along the Paseo de la Reforma. He will also visit General Motors staff in the city before taking to the track in the MAC-26. Cadillac has also announced a renewed contract with the Mexican through to 2029.
Asked about the celebrations when speaking at the Autosport Business Exchange New York, Reuss said: "It's a big deal.

"It'll be Checo's 300th, really proud to have him driving for our team, and he's given us so much feedback, and expertise on someone who's run the tracks - and [Valtteri] Bottas - both giving us real feedback around the car, the track, and what the differences are and how to build the models, and how to get those simulations right as we move through and experience our first season.

"This is a big deal for him. It's also a big deal for General Motors. Our Mexico headquarters is in Mexico City, so he's going to speak to our dealers, he's going to speak to our employees, and I can't wait to go and be part of that with him, and all of his fans.

"He's just a great person, who he is as a person; because he's not only a wonderful driver, a wonderful representative for Cadillac and General Motors and Formula 1, but he's just a really good person.
"It's an honour to have him."
Perez and Bottas joined Cadillac for its maiden F1 season this term, bringing race-winning experience to the GM brand as it made its first steps into the pinnacle of single-seater racing.
And while the season has been far from smooth sailing, which was to be expected for a new team built from zero, Reuss has been impressed with the character shown by both drivers.
"They're very different," he revealed. "Any driver in any series is always, if they're really good, very different.

"In that professionalism and precision, whatever series it is, whether it's endurance, Formula 1, off-road, trucks, I don't care what it is, you can see it in the champions, and they strive to do the best, the very best they can every race and if they don't, if something happens - you can't win every race, no one can win every race - when they have a day that is unfortunate or mistakes were made, they move on from that race, and perfect their craft, whether it's with the car, or themselves or their physicality, or whatever that is.
"They drive for that perfection, and both of these gentlemen do that, and they really understand what it takes and the process. I'm very, very happy that they're patient with us to be honest.
"That takes a special person, and both of those guys have it."
